acceptance_profile.eligibility: Consume CCP-01 category/owner routing and CCP-02 identity/agency profiles; do not infer that every creature is tameable, recruitable, rescuable or bond-eligible.
acceptance_profile.sapient_agency: Source-confirmed sapient beings remain autonomous; recruitment/bond formation must preserve explicit consent and can never become ownership or automatic obedience by default.
acceptance_profile.pathways: Represent distinct rescue, recruitment, taming and bond-formation pathways with explicit source/profile/GM disposition rather than one universal success formula.
acceptance_profile.relationship_boundary: MIB-09 retains relationship identity and numeric relationship state; CCP-03 may define governed proposals/events/seams but cannot create a duplicate relationship ledger.
acceptance_profile.later_tranches: CCP-04 retains training/commands/tasks/tricks/behavior; CCP-05 care/welfare; CCP-06 mount/work/travel; CCP-07 combat/familiar mechanics; CCP-08 breeding; CCP-09 facilities; CCP-10 ecology; CCP-11 packaging/final proof.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused CCP-03 verifier plus exact-head repository health and governed Linux/Windows deterministic Validation Core must pass before merge.
